origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Abyssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: Cretoor y dowin — armored, sniessey ayns ushtaghyn, as able dy gholl gys guardian allies.Slow as dry out er thalloo.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Ta’n ushtey ry-anmey cho najooragh as an aer as ta’n ushtey ry-akin soilleil trooid eh fegooish foggyrt.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Mines ec y speed laghyn tra t'ad fo'n ushtey.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: Mow eh beggan ny s’fast trooid ushtey.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Ushtey Foshlit
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: Swims stereo clear jeh'n ghrunt-marrey, cha nee ny-lomarcan er-gerrey da.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Boayl Neutral
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: Holds doigh tra t'eh ry-hoi ry-hoi ayns ynnyd dy scughey.Ta'n swoaie sheese obbraghey foast myr t'eh.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Bee-eeagh;
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Cha vod agh iasg y ee.Faggys stiureyderyn freayst eh shoh ayns config (ocean_origins.diet_eish_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: Ta cod as salmon cruin cho glen as ny versionyn cooit.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: T'eh glenney trooid ushtey lesh stroiks creeney, efficient — fadane ny s'faggys da'n 'surface-dweller'.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Sushtal adaptit gys dorraghys absolute.Toggle rish y key Vision Oie (K ry-hoi).
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Returns 30% jeh'n daah t'er ny gheddyn ry-cheilley rish ny h-ionnsaidee.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 chree (+4 HP ny smoo).Biology y marrey dowin t'eh toiggal frame hardier.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Mines ec y speed laghyn agh tra t'ad er nyn stroie.
T'eh slaynt ry-cheilley tra t'eh ayns ushtey — mysh 1 HP gagh 3 second.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: Ta 1.5 dagh second y ghoaill tra t'eh ry-gheddyn rish soilshey y ghrian.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: T'eh sheeyney magh
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Ta'n aer tikkey sheese tra t'ou er-mayrn: surface ro-hiar as t'ou suffocate.Ta'n fliaghey, cauldron ushtey, Breathing Ushtey ny conduit glan ry-hoi ry-hoi, ooilley ny t'ad ry-hoi.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Cooidjagh;
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: A being touch by the End — t’eh phase trooid blockanyn, t’eh blinkey rish y traa t’er n’gholl shaghey, as t’eh coshee nagh vel y chooid smoo jeh ny threishteilaghyn er nyn shilley.Sprints gyn stayd, agh ushtey ta agony.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Blinks gys raad t'ou uss shooyl (sushtal 24 block).Costey 2 energy.80-tik cooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Can see ayns dorraghys immeeaght.Toggle rish y key Vision Oie (K ry-hoi).
Mobs cha vel ad fakin dy vel oo ayn, mannagh vel oo ymmyrkey orroo.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Ta 1 dagh second y ghoaill tra t'eh ayns ushtey ny fliaghey — ta'n void aggle ushtey.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: Sprinting cha nel eh costail ec y traa t'ayn.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Gard cloie.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: Rug jeh clogh beo — sentinel un-chreeagh ta sheeyney sniaghtey er y vioys, mynney creg lesh laueyn bog, as cur torchyn glowstone ayns y dorraghys.Cha vel thalloo slane, agh nagh vel ry-chlashtyn, er nyn stroie.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 creeaghyn (+6 HP ny smoo).Corp cloie t'eh geddyn ny smoo na flesh.
Returns 20% jeh'n daah t'er ny gheddyn rish ny h-ionnsaidee.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Brishey blockanyn daa cheayrt ny s'fast.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: Cha nel monsteryn ry-gheddyn ayns 48 block.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: Glass;
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: Corp beo jeh'n theihll glass — gyn stayd, ayns shee rish y ghrian, agh sniessey dy chooilley red liorish corruptaght y Nether.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: All mobs — goaill stiagh ny hostile — t’ad jannoo ymmyd jeh’n aght shoh, mannagh vel ad er nyn provoke.
Cushion freayll gagh fall.Takes nish dagh fall.
power.neoorigins.verdant_no_hunger_sprin: Sprinting cha nel eh costail ec y traa t'ayn.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Ta'n slaynt ry-gheddyn ry-cheilley tra t'eh ayns biomes coastal.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: Ta 2 dagh second y ghoaill tra t'eh 'sy Nether.Boots Frost Walker t'ad ymmyrkey yn daggey.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: Leshtal jeh scadoo — thrown orbs dy nerve dorragh, dash eddyr positionyn, as deflect saighdyn.Swift ayns y dorraghys, losht liorish soilshey y ghrian.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: Ta'n dorraghys immeeaght.Toggle rish y key Vision Oie (K ry-hoi).
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Dash Scadoo
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Bursts roish lesh speed ard ayns y raad ta shiu glenney.Costey 2 energy.60-tik cooilleeney.
Ta 1 dagh second y ghoaill tra t'eh ry-akin rish soilshey y ghrian.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: Ta saighdyn goll dy h-arrymagh trooid dty form s’shaghney.
power.neoorigins.umbral_no_hunger_sprint: Sprinting cha nel eh costail ec y traa t'ayn.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Orb scadoo
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Cur orb nagh vel er ny hoiggal ta plung radius 28-block ayns Dooghys.Sushtal 4 orbs glan 'sy traa;cur stiagh fer noa, t’eh y fer s’anmey y chur magh.Costey 2 energy.60-tik cooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: Pounces oo cummaltagh ayns y raad t'ou uss shooyl.Costey 2 energy.4-second y chooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Skeeanyn Dragoon
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Glides s'leaie trooid an aer liorish ymmyd jeh skianyn draconic cummaltagh.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Breaths burst 4 ballaghyn beggey ayns y raad ta shiu shooyl.Costey 3 stayd.4-second y chooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Bendiaght Nature
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: Ta crouaghyn ry-cheilley crooit ny s’faggys da’n ghrian, myr dy beagh ad bendigit liorish y thalloo.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Cur stiagh
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Roots ooilley ny cretooryn ry-cheilley ayns nyn stayd lesh Slowness VI cummaltagh son 4 secondyn.Costey 2 bea.200-tik cooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Phaseyn trooid mullagh solid ayns y raad ta shiu shooyl.3-second y chooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: T'eh shooyl bolt dy nerve withering ta ploogh ayns sthie dy mraane s'doillee.Costey 1 energy.4-second y chooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: Grant trident enchanted cummaltagh (Reesht, Unbree III, Riptide III) tra t'ou uss roshtyn y t'er-ny-gheddyn.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: Cretooryn 'sy 'ocean' passive — squid, iasg, dolphinyn — t'ad teaghey veih oo tra t'ad er nyn shilley.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: Phase trooid mullagh solid ayns y raad ta shiu shooyl.Costey 3 energy.80-tik cooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Cur block glowstone er y slyst ta shiu jeeaghyn er.100-tik cooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: As brishey crouaghyn ny loggyn aibish, t'eh cur rish un set drops elley.
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.max_reach: Ta'n chooid smoo jeh'n minions er nyn goyrt magh!
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.not_enoug: Cha nel accrys doaltattym dy ghoaill!

origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Inchling
origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: Humanoid quarter-sized ta scaalaghey balley lesh ymmyd as glenney lesh speed ymmyrchagh — agh ta corp fragile cheet marish y chreeagh.
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.name: Diminuit.
Can cling rish as scaal erbee.
power.neoorigins.inchling_no_fall_damage: So light nagh vel tuittym erbee goit.

power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: T'eh geddyn accrys lesh leshtal cho s'fast as clowan normal.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Sporaghey
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: Cretoor fungal ta threeisht ayns dorraghys as mushroomyn — armit lesh spooryn toxicagh, agh t'eh shleaystey liorish soilshey y ghrian.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: T'eh shooyl projectile spore ta shleaystey ayns cloan sporeyn poisonous.Costey 3 bea.12-second y chooilleeney.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_poison_immuni: Immune da ooilley ny h-effeityn poison.
Can see soilshey ayns dorraghys immeeaght.Toggle rish y key Vision Oie (K ry-hoi).
